rationale: PP03 flagged rows are real comparative-period leakage. The later SOI block contains the cited flagged rows and totals to fair value 11,549,149.4, matching the comparative 2024 total, while the current 2025 SOI block totals to 21,508,598.4 and contains current-period versions of the same positions with different coupons. Retaining the comparative rows under report_date 2025-12-31 is therefore a source-grounded data error.
